reward.title: Faction bounty
reward.description: Representatives of a local faction tracked you down. The boss you eliminated had an unclaimed bounty. They settle the debt. +{{amount}} cr · +5 reputation.

threat.title: Retaliation expected
threat.description: The boss's associates found your trail. A message left with the local barkeep: "You killed someone who had friends. We remember." Someone's watching you now. -8 reputation.

mystery.title: What the boss was hiding
mystery.description: Among the boss's personal effects, an encrypted datapad. The data bears your name — and a date three weeks before your arrival in the sector. Someone was following you before the confrontation even happened.

reward.title: The stalker had enemies
reward.description: A faceless intermediary approaches you. Brief. Discreet. "He had a lot of enemies. You did us a favor." A purse changes hands. +{{amount}} cr.

mystery.title: He wasn't working alone
mystery.description: An anonymous message, untraceable source: "You handled the problem well. But you should know — he wasn't working alone. What he was looking for on you, others are still looking for. Be careful."

info.title: Who sent him?
info.description: In the stalker's travel logs, a lead. A financial transaction from a station you know. Someone paid to have you found. You don't know why yet.

faucons.title: Message from Cael — The Falcons
faucons.description: "The Falcons don't do compliments. But good work deserves recognition. Here's your cut." A direct, clean payment. +1,200 cr.

emporium.title: Commission from Pistis — The Emporium
emporium.description: An automatic transfer. Cold, precise, no comment. Then a message from Pistis: "Efficiency noted. Continue." +900 cr · +3 reputation.

gardiens.title: Supplies from Myrra — The Guardians
gardiens.description: A package delivered in your name. Medicine, a unit of fuel, and a note from Myrra: "The Guardians don't forget their own. Stay alive." +2 Medicine · +1 fuel · +5 rep.

culte.title: Words from Neva — The Cult
culte.description: An excerpt from the Book of the Void, unpublished chapter, sent personally by Neva. The words are unsettling. You don't know yet if this is a reward or a warning. +8 reputation.

consequence.title: Informal tax
consequence.description: The Emporium flagged your profile. An "administrative" fee is automatically deducted from your next transactions. -200 cr.

threat.title: Guardian warrant
threat.description: Your behavior has been documented enough to justify a preventive warrant. The Guardians have officially logged your file. Affiliated stations won't welcome you warmly. -12 reputation.

info.title: Reputation precedes you
info.description: An informant sold your behavior profile on the black network. There are multiple buyers. Some are curious. Others have more concrete reasons. -5 reputation.

consequence.title: Emporium commission
consequence.description: The Emporium monitors major financial flows in the sector. Your assets triggered an alert. A "supervision fee" is deducted. It's legal under the Requiem Accord. -500 cr.

reward.title: Loyal client
reward.description: A merchant you've regularly dealt with sends a surprise commission. "For loyalty. The sector's short on reliable people." +350 cr.

threat.title: Financial profile compromised
threat.description: Someone put your financial profile into circulation on the black network. Estimated worth, recent transactions, current station. Some people are interested. Some people have plans. Stay alert. -5 reputation.

consequence.title: Arrest warrant
consequence.description: The Guardians issued an official warrant following your escape. Distributed to affiliated stations. Your standing in the sector takes an immediate hit. -15 reputation.

reward.title: Cell memento
reward.description: Your former cellmate sent you something. A message: "You taught me to hold on. Here's what I can do for you." Supplies hidden at the station entrance. +2 Medicine · +1 fuel.

mystery.title: What the guard knew
mystery.description: A prison guard contacts you anonymously. "I saw your file. There are things in there you don't know about yourself. Connections you haven't made. If you want to know — find me." No station. No name.
